newsitem.title: SPAIN: Demand for Telefonica exceeds retail offer.
newsitem.headline: Demand for Telefonica exceeds retail offer.

text.p: Demand for Telefonica de Espana shares on the second day of the sale of Spain's final 20.9 percent stake in the group exceeded the amount initially allocated for the retail tranche, according to the local press.
The demand reached nearly 300 billion pesetas, more than covering the original allotment - which can be expanded by 10 percent - of 85.54 million shares, the paper said.
Telefonica was not available for immediate comment.
The share offer is open until February 14.
Telefonica said the initial offering size was of 171 million shares, of which 50 percent would be offered domestically. The retail tranche is 58.4 percent.
Shares in Telefonica ended Tuesday, the second day of the retail subscription period, wiih a rise of 10 pesetas to 3,395, down from a new historic maximum of 3,420 pesetas on Monday.
